//: Atlas — macOS Spotlight-style overlay search prototype.
Stack: Vite + React + TypeScript (renderer) running inside an Electron shell
with a separately-compiled TypeScript main process.
Note on comments: package.json is strict JSON (no // or /* */). npm only
honours the exact key "//" as a comment — any other name like
"//scripts" or "//react-runtime" is interpreted as a real field (and,
inside dependencies, as a real package name, which fails install).
So all comments for this file live in this single "//" key, as an array
of strings. Docs below are organised by the section they describe.
FIELD: main
Electron's entry point after TS compilation. tsc emits main.ts ->
dist-electron/main.js (see tsconfig.main.json). Electron reads this
field to know which file to execute in the main process.
SCRIPTS:
start       — user-facing alias for `dev` so muscle memory works.
dev         — runs Vite + Electron concurrently. `-k` kills siblings
when one dies, preventing orphaned Electron windows.
dev:vite    — Vite dev server on :5173 with HMR.
dev:electron — waits for Vite, compiles main.ts -> dist-electron/,
launches Electron with VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL pointing at
the dev server so main.ts loadURL()s it.
build       — prod bundle: Vite -> dist/, tsc -> dist-electron/.
No packaging step yet (electron-builder etc.) — deferred
until we're closer to shipping the prototype.
typecheck   — noEmit pass across both tsconfigs. Pre-commit gate later.
DEPENDENCIES (runtime):
react / react-dom — React 18 for concurrent features (transitions,
automatic batching) even if we don't lean on them.
DEV DEPENDENCIES:
electron              — Chromium + Node shell for the overlay.
vite / @vitejs/plugin-react — renderer bundler + Fast Refresh + auto JSX.
typescript + @types/* — TS compiler and DOM/Node/React type defs.
concurrently          — runs vite + electron in one terminal.
wait-on               — blocks electron until vite is serving.
cross-env             — cross-platform env var setting (overkill on Mac
only, but cheap insurance if a teammate is on Linux).
name: atlas

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
